controls.title: Controls
mode.SwapTiles.help.pad: Move with the D-pad, press A on a tile, then A on another to swap them.
mode.SwapTiles.help.keys: Move with the arrow keys, press Enter on a tile, then Enter on another to swap them.
mode.Strips.help.pad: Press A on a strip, move to its place, then press A: the others make room.
mode.Strips.help.keys: Press Enter on a strip, move to its place with the arrows, then Enter: the others make room.
mode.Sliding.help.pad: Push the tiles into the gap with the D-pad.
mode.Sliding.help.keys: Push the tiles into the gap with the arrow keys.
mode.Rotate.help.pad: Move with the D-pad: A turns a tile, RB turns it the other way.
mode.Memory.help.pad: Move with the D-pad: A turns a card over. Find every pair to uncover the picture.
mode.Rotate.help.keys: Move with the arrow keys: Enter turns a tile, Q turns it the other way.
mode.Memory.help.keys: Move with the arrow keys: Enter turns a card over. Find every pair to uncover the picture.
